comments.author: @CebollinoPro
comments.text: Mexico is truly a beautiful country, but something foreigners often fail to notice is that we live in fear. Horrific disappearances are claiming countless lives—there are at least 145,000+ people who remain unaccounted for, and that figure only includes those fortunate enough to have been officially registered as missing. Criminals show no regard for their own people; their conflicts end in tragedy, damaging historical sites, water access, infrastructure, and more. I hope that you, our friends from abroad, will become aware of this sad reality. 🫂💔
